post.summary: Pre-Checkin a Reservation using guest / profile details.
post.description:
This will allow you to set a reservation as a pre-registered guest. The API request requires the guests confirmation number and you can optionally include arrival time. The behavior of the API will be dependent upon the Pre-registration rules configured for the hotel in OPERA Cloud administration.

OperationId:postPreCheckInGuestReservation
